label: Lt Col Dwynne Arneson
narrative: Dwynne Arneson was a communications officer with the 28th Air Division at Malmstrom AFB in 1967 and one of the seven veterans at the 27 September 2010 National Press Club event, where he executed an affidavit. His secondary importance to this cluster is as the relay for a remark attributed to the Boeing engineer Robert Kaminski about the Echo Flight missiles, which is a second-hand statement carried here as a second-hand statement and nothing more. His own account, like those of the other affiants, reaches the public first at that press conference.
